document.abstract: We have developed a family of technologies that address the utilization of frequency spectrum and we are a proponent for a U.S, HDTV terrestrial transmission system. We have applied our Genesys™ Technologies to create the only single channel, fully compatible simulcast HDTV system.

authors.bio: Richard Gerdes has been involved in the design of video and image processing systems since 1960. In 1962, while employed by Kitt Peak National Obervatory, he designed and built a 4000-line raster progressive scan, a 4000-line horizontal resolution orthicon system for astronomical applications. From 1965 to 1976, Gerdes developed direct view, vector-based three-dimensional imaging systems used in Hollywood-produced movies, television programs, and laser light shows. From 1979 to now, he designed a number of monolithic integrated circuits for professiona audio and video system equipment manufacturers Since 1982, he been involved in the development of the GenesysTM technologies and resulting hardware. Gerdes received a B.S.E.E. degree in 1962 and did post-graduate work at the University of Arizone. He holds several patents in the signal processing and communication fields. He is a member of the SMPTE. AES. IEEE and the SID
